name: Scriv
text: Scriv: Routing *all* zero-speech videos to curation with a "Needs Manual Review" label shifts 30% of uploads to a team that isn’t scaled for it—curation’s 30-second review adds hours weekly, and their core job is high-value content, not triage. Instead, task ingestion to route *only* videos under 10 seconds with zero speech to curation; longer silent videos (sign language, narrated slides) go to transcript with a "Silent but valid" flag. Settle this with a pilot: run the 10-second rule for a week, measure curation load and misclassification rates, then decide.
